root_cause.summary: EndCredits fits font size using glyph advance only, then renders 0.6px letter spacing; the long music row therefore exceeds the unchanged936px safe width. The checker includes tracking when measuring, so its failure is correct.
root_cause.classification: Renderer layout defect; the checker's mirrored size calculation must change with the renderer, but its width threshold is not wrong.
